official_notice: February 2012 original report says semiconductor media such as smart cards and flash memory cards were reclassified into semiconductors and related devices effective with January 2012 statistics; June 2012 annual revision would revise goods statistics back to 2009.
decision: Exclude January 2012 same-report current/prior MoM from any future factor source because its December 2011 prior may retain the pre-January category definition. Equality of printed 3438 values does not prove restatement.
post_transition: February 2012 current 3621 and same-release January prior 3678 are both post-effective months; future source design may use within-report MoM from February onward, subject to full vintage/timing checks.
reopen_only_with: Contemporaneous official bridge or January release note explicitly showing December 2011 was recomputed under the post-January definition, or exact category adjustment for December.
